body: From the DM-188 review (orchestrator, this run): measuring cross-repo corrective work is yours. After DM-188 lets results cite sealed grades of correction epics (same repo, verified by marker + provenance), extend it to a correction epic in the Dark Mechanicus source checkout: the target's sealed scorecard must travel back with DM-190's receipt (or be read from the target project through requireAvailable at record time) so a source experiment's result can cite it and the before/after outcome links back to the source; the same comparability rules apply.
